protocol_declaration: I am testing RallyHub under Master Testing Blueprint v1.3 and RallyHub Testing Control Pack v1.0. I will not substitute my own testing process for the required protocol without recording and justifying the deviation.

deviations: Repository-wide lint is blocked by two pre-existing unused imports in MemberMessages.jsx; Finance-specific ESLint passed.
Repository-wide typecheck is not a usable release signal because of pre-existing project-wide Leaflet/UI primitive typing errors.

environment_proof.test_data_or_sandbox: Authenticated Clare Pickleball admin fixture; Spond event-pattern fixtures based on Clare production DirectorySpondEvent identifiers and venue/session patterns.
environment_failures: Initial Playwright runs were BLOCKED by missing Chromium/Linux dependencies; dependencies were installed and tests rerun.
Existing E2E route interception matched /src/api/base44Client.js and prevented the app mounting; harness was corrected from **/api/** to **/api/apps/** and tests rerun.

test_cases.scenario: Recurring Spond occurrence IDs change week-to-week.
test_cases.expected_result: Exact original IDs match first; later occurrences safely match by venue + weekday + local start time; unrelated Corofin/wrong-time events do not mis-match.
test_cases.notes: Regression fixture includes Ennistymon and Doora occurrence patterns.

test_cases.scenario: Admin opens Finance Summary, sees instructions/Spond status, selects multiple venues, syncs Spond, reads diagnostics/results, and opens recurring-session setup only when needed.
test_cases.expected_result: Journey completes without page errors; multi-select works; synced rows and skipped reasons are visible.

test_cases.scenario: Spond responds successfully but zero finance rows match.
test_cases.expected_result: UI explicitly says Spond connected/returned events and explains unmatched/missing-fee skips rather than silently showing zero.

test_cases.scenario: Finance Summary on 390x844 mobile viewport before and after Spond sync.
test_cases.expected_result: No horizontal page overflow; sync feedback remains usable.
Route stays phone-width with desktop sidebar closed.

test_cases.scenario: Production build, Finance-specific ESLint, and Spond backend bundling.
test_cases.actual_result: npm run build passed; Finance-specific ESLint passed; esbuild backend bundle passed.
test_cases.notes: Full repo lint/typecheck have unrelated pre-existing failures recorded in limitations.

defects.summary: Finance sync matched only the originally stored Spond event ID, so later recurring occurrences could produce zero finance rows.
defects.reproduction: Sync a later recurring Ennistymon occurrence whose Spond occurrence ID differs from the stored first event ID.

defects.summary: FinanceSummary JSX edit contained a missing closing brace and would not build.
defects.reproduction: Run npm run build on the intermediate revision.

defects.summary: Shared Playwright API route matcher intercepted /src/api/base44Client.js, preventing authenticated app tests from mounting.
defects.reproduction: Use page.route('**/api/**') against Vite source path /src/api/base44Client.js.

persistence_proof.proof_notes: Base44 checkpoint created after the green Finance/browser/build gates.

deployment_proof.notes: Production Spond secret-backed finance sync cannot be proven from sandbox; verify after republish without asking the user to diagnose the flow.

limitations: Live Spond API/comment payload and persisted ClubFinanceEntry production rows require a post-publish production verification.
Repository-wide lint has unrelated MemberMessages.jsx unused-import failures.
Repository-wide typecheck has broad pre-existing Leaflet/UI typing failures and is not green.
next_actions: After publish, run the live Clare Spond Finance sync and inspect persisted ClubFinanceEntry rows and September totals.
Only then promote from RELEASE-CANDIDATE to PRODUCTION-PROVEN.
